calls.price_at_call: over $1,000 (stated; ~$2,073 in June, down ~30% in 3 months); P/E low 20s
calls.thesis: BUY first tracked (guest Joel Litman, Altimetry Research, on uniform-accounting fundamentals) — Comfort Systems is a top AI-infrastructure enabler pick: HVAC/cooling for data centres and US reindustrialisation, backlog off the charts, earnings and revenue growing, valuation still reasonable for the growth; the 30% drop is market sentiment, not fundamentals.
calls.base_case: Backlog keeps growing, customers keep coming, pricing power rising; a low-20s P/E on 20-30% earnings growth is reasonable.
calls.bull_case: AI data-centre build-out plus US reindustrialisation keeps cooling demand growing for years; smaller enablers can double or triple.
calls.bear_case: Sector-wide sell-off drags even strong names; growth could slow if the AI build-out pauses.
calls.video_title: 2 Stocks You'll Wish You Bought on the Dip (And 1 You'll Regret Owning)

calls.thesis: Comfort Systems USA: signal 'buy a lot' dialled back by his system to 'buy a little' (priced near top of own range, PEG ~1.3). Sales +50% and EPS nearly doubled last quarter, backlog ~$14B (+73% YoY), profits expected +23% next year. Condition: wait for earnings in a few days, then build a case. First tracked BWB call on FIX.
calls.base_case: Forecasts raised ~11% since July (7 raises, 0 cuts in last month) while stock -16% since July.
calls.bull_case: Tech/data-centre customers now ~60% of sales vs 43% a year ago; beat estimates 4 quarters in a row.
calls.bear_case: Backlog depends on big-tech build pace; most jobs fixed-price, so labour/material overruns hit profit directly.
